registryAssessment: Adamawa State’s Ministry of Lands and Survey is located in Yola and documents services including Certificates of Occupancy, land surveying, and mapping. The state Digital Archive catalogs CofOs, location maps and parcel survey diagrams; its interface requires login. A 2026 state report says the new land-administration platform was still moving toward full deployment and describes applicant/record workflow modules, not a public anonymous parcel-vector service.
